options.command: VERSION=$(tr -d '\r\n' < cmd/mindctl/VERSION) && COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD) && DATE=$(git show -s --format=%cI HEAD) && mkdir -p dist/apps/mindctl && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$VERSION -X main.commit=$COMMIT -X main.date=$DATE" -o dist/apps/mindctl/mindctl ./cmd/mindctl
echo 'Mindctl artifacts are published by the router release workflow.'
